title: Door-opening heat shielding and cable protection on a box furnace for titanium-alloy forgings
summary: A Suneng chamber-furnace proposal for heating titanium-alloy forgings and other large metal forgings places heating elements on the door. A heat shield behind the raised door separates its hot face from roof-mounted thermocouples, compensating cables and nearby equipment. Reviewing this arrangement requires checking both the heating layout with the door closed and the direction of the exposed hot face with it open. Disconnecting heating power as the door rises does not mean the hot face has cooled.
